facts.value: Supplemental wages identified separately, income tax withheld from regular wages in the current or preceding year: either flat 22% or aggregate - add the supplemental wages to the concurrently paid regular wages (or, if none, to the regular wages of the current or preceding payroll period), figure the tax as if one regular-period payment, subtract the tax withheld or to be withheld from the regular wages, withhold the remainder; earlier supplemental payments of the same period are aggregated too. No income tax withheld from regular wages in the current or preceding year: aggregate method only. Supplemental wages paid with regular wages without specifying each amount: withhold on the total as one regular payment.
